profile_text.body:
Saul is listed with the website counsel.com. The text harvested from that site describes WealthCounsel, which the site presents as a resource for legal document software, trust and estate planning software, legal marketing, and continuing legal education courses. The site describes membership tiers: an Elite membership that includes Wealth Docx Complete, Elder Docx, Business Docx, Wealth Tracx, and Gun Docx, and a Trusts and Estates Professional membership that includes Wealth Docx Complete, Business Docx, Wealth Tracx, and Gun Docx. It also describes cloud-based drafting software for elder law, special needs, and Veterans pension planning documents, a drafting system for business planning documents, and software for firearms trusts and conventional and National Firearms Act firearms planning. The site additionally mentions combining WealthCounsel with LEAP for practice management integration, along with webinars, articles, and other practice building material.

On the AI side, the record for Saul lists one product, SaulLM (Saul), described as a French legal-domain large language model with specialized training and EU data governance. No other AI products are listed for the company.

The record contains no litigation, no MCP servers, and no SEC or patent facts for Saul.
